title: LIMON HOME Washable Area Rug 6x9, Large Soft Rugs for Living Room Vintage Beige Floral Rug 6 by 9 Area Rugs for Bedroom Dining Room Non-Slip Stain Resistant Under Table Rug
features: 【Tight and Thick Pile】:LIMON HOME's newly developed thickened rug features a plush weave that is thicker and denser than the old models on the market. It can provide excellent protection for your phone if it falls, unlike being as thin as paper.

【Better Anti-Slip Back】:This rug features an anti-slip silicone backing, with 5,184 silicone particles per square foot that can firmly fix it in place, minimizing movement and slipping. It is particularly suitable for areas with high foot traffic such as entrance corridors, ensuring that children and pets can move safely. It is suitable for various types of flooring.
【The Print Does Not Easily Fade.】: Utilizing high-temperature printing technology, the color can be maintained in various environments, even under direct sunlight.

【Easy to Clean】: Surface dust and dirt are easily removed from this rug. It's machine washable, allowing for regular cleaning with a broom or vacuum to eliminate dust, dirt, or debris. For deep cleaning, we recommend using a mild detergent and washing it in cold water.

【Fold Handling】: Simply walking on the rug or placing heavy objects on it will help the creases disappear within a few days. Alternatively, gently spraying water on the creases and laying the rug face down will also help.
